instructions:
# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

## Punjabi (pa)

Script: Gurmukhi. Used in Punjab and Chandigarh, and spoken in Delhi and
Haryana.
Tone: everyday spoken Punjabi.
Words: ਆਨਲਾਈਨ, ਫਾਰਮ, ਪੋਰਟਲ, ਲੌਗਇਨ, ਆਧਾਰ, ਬੈਂਕ, ਮੋਬਾਈਲ, OTP, ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ, ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ,
ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ, ਅਪਲੋਡ.
UI: ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਓ, ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰੋ, ਅੱਗੇ, ਪਿੱਛੇ, ਖੋਜੋ, ਸਾਂਝਾ ਕਰੋ, ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ, ਭਾਸ਼ਾ, ਮਦਦ.
Offices: ਤਹਿਸੀਲਦਾਰ, ਪਟਵਾਰੀ, ਸੇਵਾ ਕੇਂਦਰ, ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਪੰਚਾਇਤ, ਡਿਪਟੀ ਕਮਿਸ਼ਨਰ.
Gender: ਲਿੰਗ. Money: ₹6,000; ₹8 ਲੱਖ. September: ਸਤੰਬਰ.

## Odia (or)

Script: Odia. Used in Odisha.
Tone: everyday spoken Odia.
Words: ଅନଲାଇନ, ଫର୍ମ, ପୋର୍ଟାଲ, ଲଗଇନ, ଆଧାର, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ, ମୋବାଇଲ, OTP, ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ, ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ,
ଡାଉନଲୋଡ, ଅପଲୋଡ.
UI: ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଦାଖଲ କରନ୍ତୁ, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ, ପଛକୁ, ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ, ସେୟାର କରନ୍ତୁ, ସେଟିଂସ୍, ଭାଷା, ସାହାଯ୍ୟ.
Offices: ତହସିଲଦାର, ବିଡିଓ, ଗ୍ରାମ ପଞ୍ଚାୟତ, ଜିଲ୍ଲାପାଳ (କଲେକ୍ଟର), ମୋ ସେବା କେନ୍ଦ୍ର.
Gender: ଲିଙ୍ଗ. Money: ଟ.6,000; ଟ.8 ଲକ୍ଷ. September: ସେପ୍ଟେମ୍ବର.

items.t: The Telangana government gives a one-time Rs.1,00,116 for the marriage of a girl from an SC, ST, BC or EBC family, or Rs.1,25,145 if the bride has a disability. The money is paid into the bride's mother's bank account. Apply after the wedding on the Telangana ePASS site, yourself or at a MeeSeva centre, then take the printout and documents to the Tahsildar's office for checking. Brides from minority communities apply under Shaadi Mubarak instead.
Rs.1,00,116 one time (Rs.1,25,145 for a bride with a disability)
The bride is from an SC, ST, BC or EBC family and lives in Telangana
Parents' total income: SC and ST up to Rs.2,00,000 a year; BC and EBC up to Rs.2,00,000 in towns and Rs.1,50,000 in villages
The bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21 on the wedding day
Only for the bride's first marriage
The bride's mother needs a bank account in her own name. A bride whose parents have died uses her own account
Aadhaar of the bride, her mother and the groom
Caste-cum-nativity certificate and income certificate from MeeSeva (you enter their numbers in the form)
Bride's age proof: SSC hall ticket number, or a birth certificate
Marriage certificate (registration), one wedding photo, and the wedding card if available
First-marriage confirmation certificate and the VRO / Panchayat Secretary certificate
Bank passbooks of the bride's mother and the bride
Bride's photo; SADAREM disability certificate if the bride has a disability
SSC or equivalent details available / Hall ticket no.
With the hall ticket number and pass year, the bride's details are taken from the SSC records. Choose No if she did not write SSC.
As on Aadhaar and the SSC memo.
She must have been 18 or older on the wedding day.
As written on the MeeSeva caste certificate.
This decides the income limit for BC/EBC: Rs.1.5 lakh in villages, Rs.2 lakh in towns.
Number on the MeeSeva income certificate. The name, mandal and income then fill in by themselves.
An account in the mother's own name, with IFSC. The money is paid here.
Name of the bride groom / Date of birth

Date and place of marriage / registration
11-05-2026, Sri Venkateswara Temple, Jagtial; SRO Jagtial, Doc No. 9999/2026
Get the caste-cum-nativity and income certificates from MeeSeva and register the marriage. Scan every document from the original (JPG, 50 to 150 KB).
Open telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in, go to Kalyana Lakshmi and click Registration, or ask a MeeSeva centre to apply for you.

Fill in the bride's details, the mother's bank details, the groom's details and the marriage details, and enter the MeeSeva certificate numbers. Upload the files and submit, then note the application ID and print it.
Take the printout and copies of the documents to the Tahsildar (MRO) office. The Revenue Inspector checks them and the RDO approves.

Shaadi Mubarak (Rs.1,00,116 Marriage Help for Minorities)

The Telangana government gives a one-time Rs.1,00,116 for the marriage of a girl from a Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Jain, Buddhist or Parsi family, or Rs.1,25,145 if the bride has a disability. It works like Kalyana Lakshmi: apply online after the nikah or wedding on the Telangana ePASS site or at MeeSeva, then take the printout and documents to the Tahsildar's office. The money is paid into the bride's mother's bank account.
The bride is from a minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Jain, Buddhist or Parsi) and lives in Telangana
Parents' total income up to Rs.2,00,000 a year
The bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21 on the date of marriage
Integrated certificate (caste-cum-nativity-cum-date of birth) and income certificate from MeeSeva
Marriage certificate: Nikahnama from the Qazi, or the church or registration certificate
Letter from the religious head who performed the marriage
One marriage photo and the bride's photo
SADAREM disability certificate, if the bride has a disability
Gives the bride's details from SSC records. Choose No if she did not write SSC.
She must have been 18 or older on the date of the nikah.
Choose as on your MeeSeva certificate: BC-E for BC-E Muslim groups, OC (Christian), OC (Sikh) and so on.
The income on the certificate must be Rs.2 lakh a year or less.
The caste-cum-nativity-cum-date of birth certificate number from MeeSeva.
He must have been 21 or older on the date of marriage.
As written in the Nikahnama or marriage certificate.
Get the integrated and income certificates from MeeSeva and the Nikahnama or marriage certificate. Scan everything from the originals (JPG, 50 to 150 KB).
Open telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in, go to Shaadi Mubarak and click Registration, or ask a MeeSeva centre to apply for you.
Fill in the bride's details, the mother's bank details, the groom's details and the marriage details, and enter the MeeSeva numbers. Upload the files, submit, and print the application with its ID.
Track the application with Print/Status. If there is an objection, correct it through Edit/Uploads.

Mukhyamantri Konya Bibaha Yojana (MKBY, Girls' Marriage Help)
Social Welfare & Social Education Department, Government of Tripura

Tripura gives Rs.50,000 once for the marriage of a girl from an Antyodaya (poorest) family, when the bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21. Up to two girls in one family can get it. You apply at the CDPO office, which checks the papers and sends them to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate within 15 days. The SDM pays once the marriage is confirmed and registered. The scheme was notified in August 2025 and covers about 2,000 girls a year.
Rs.50,000 once, for each eligible girl (up to two girls per family)
The bride must be 18 or older and the groom 21 or older on the date of marriage
The bride's family must be in the state's Antyodaya database (Antyodaya ration card)
The bride must be a permanent resident of Tripura (PRTC holder)
Neither bride nor groom may have a living spouse, unless the earlier marriage was legally dissolved by divorce
Help is given once per girl, for at most two girls in a family
The marriage is registered at the venue or right after it
Aadhaar card and PRTC of the bride
Age proof of the bride (birth certificate or school leaving certificate)
Antyodaya ration card of the bride's family
Aadhaar card and address proof of the groom
Passport-size photographs of bride and groom
Self-declaration on marital status, signed by both bride and groom (form attached)
Directorate of Social Welfare & Social Education, Tripura

The Child Development Project Office (CDPO) of the ICDS project where the bride lives. Hand in the filled form with photocopies of every document and the self-declaration signed by both bride and groom, and keep the originals to show. The CDPO forwards it to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) within 15 days. If you are refused, appeal to the District Magistrate & Collector, who must decide within 10 days.

Age and date of birth of bride

As written on the groom's Aadhaar.

Fill this only if the wedding has already taken place. The SDM confirms the marriage before paying.

The marriage is registered, either at a mass marriage event held by the SDM or on its own, and the SDM confirms it.
After confirmation, Rs.50,000 is sanctioned and paid into the bride's bank account.
If the application is rejected, appeal to the District Magistrate & Collector.
0381-2326033 — Directorate of Social Welfare & Social Education, Agartala; your CDPO or SDM office
Chief Minister Jan Arogya Yojana (CM-JAY Card)
Tripura Health Protection Society (State Health Agency), Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Tripura

Tripura's own health cover, also called Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana, launched on 15 February 2024 for families left out of Ayushman Bharat. Every household not covered by PM-JAY, the construction workers' scheme, CAPF, PM-JANMAN or any other government insurance gets up to Rs.5 lakh a year of cashless, paperless hospital treatment, on the same pattern as PM-JAY. The state also announced free medicines for 15 days after discharge. The CM-JAY card is made free on the Ayushman beneficiary portal or app, or at a CSC or empanelled hospital.
Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless and paperless
Families living in Tripura that are not covered by AB PM-JAY, the BoCW (construction workers) scheme, CAPF, PM-JANMAN or any other government health insurance
No income limit, and no cap on family size or age
State government employees can join if they give up the yearly medical allowance
Families already in PM-JAY keep using their Ayushman card instead
Every member needs their own card, made through Aadhaar e-KYC
Aadhaar card of every member whose card is being made
Ration card, to find and link the family
Choose Beneficiary when you make the card for yourself or your family.
Any number you hold. The login OTP and the approval message come here.
Choose Tripura and the state scheme CM-JAY. If your family does not show, search again under PMJAY, because a family is in only one of the two.
You can also search by Aadhaar. The ration card brings up the whole family at once.
Copy it from the ration card. If nothing is found, try the Aadhaar number.
Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making now, one member at a time.

Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses.

Find the member marked eKYC pending, verify with an Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, and take the live photo.
Fill in the relation to the head of the family, the district and the PIN code, and submit. The State Health Agency usually approves within a day or two.
Log in again and download the CM-JAY card. Do this for every member. If you get stuck, a CSC or the Ayushman desk at an empanelled hospital will make it for free.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman desk. Treatment is cashless up to Rs.5 lakh a year, so never pay cash for a covered treatment.
14555 — Ayushman Bharat / CM-JAY national helpline / 1800-345-3797 — State Health Agency Tripura toll-free
Ujjwala Free LPG Refill on Holi and Diwali (Muft Gas Cylinder)
Food & Civil Supplies Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, with Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum and HP Gas

Families in Uttar Pradesh with a PM Ujjwala gas connection get the money for two 14.2 kg refills a year back from the state government: one between October and December (Diwali) and one between January and March (Holi). You book and pay for the cylinder as usual, and the money comes back into your Aadhaar-linked bank account in about 3 to 4 days. There is no form. The only condition is that the connection holder's Aadhaar authentication is done at the gas agency. The UP cabinet approved the 2026–27 round on 9 October 2026.
Two 14.2 kg refills a year free, with the money credited back to your bank account
A PM Ujjwala (PMUY) gas connection in Uttar Pradesh
Aadhaar authentication (e-KYC) of the connection holder done at the gas agency
A bank account linked to Aadhaar, because the money goes only to the Aadhaar-linked account
One free refill in October–December and one in January–March. A refill outside these months is not refunded
The state approves the scheme again every year. The 2026–27 round runs from October 2026 to March 2027
Gas consumer number or the LPG passbook (blue book)
Bank passbook of the account linked to Aadhaar
Ration card, if the agency asks to check the family
Your LPG distributor (Indian Oil, Bharat Gas or HP Gas)

Nothing to fill in. The Ujjwala connection holder goes to her own LPG distributor (gas agency) in person with her Aadhaar card, the gas passbook or consumer number and the bank passbook, and gets the Aadhaar fingerprint authentication (e-KYC) done for free. Where the oil company's app offers it (IndianOil ONE, Hello BPCL, HP Pay), the e-KYC can also be done at home with Aadhaar face authentication.
Printed on the gas passbook and on every cash memo.
The refund is only for Ujjwala connections. Ask the agency if you are not sure which type you have.
The woman in whose name the Ujjwala connection was given. She must go for the authentication herself.
The connection holder's own Aadhaar. Her fingerprint or face is matched against it.
The number linked to the gas connection. The booking and delivery messages come here.
It is done only once and is free. If it is pending, you will not get the refund.
Ask your bank to confirm this account is linked to Aadhaar for DBT. The money goes only here.
Book between October and December for the Diwali refill, and between January and March for the Holi refill.
Ask your gas agency whether your Aadhaar authentication is done. If not, the connection holder goes there with her Aadhaar card and gas passbook and gives her fingerprint. It is free.
Make sure your bank account is linked to Aadhaar for DBT. Ask at your bank branch if you are not sure.
Between October and December, book a refill as usual (IVRS call, missed call, WhatsApp or the app). Pay the normal price at delivery and keep the cash memo.
In about 3 to 4 days the money is credited to your Aadhaar-linked bank account. Check the bank SMS or the passbook.

Krishi Yantra Anudan — Farm Machinery Subsidy (Yantra Token Booking)
Agriculture Department (Krishi Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh

The UP Agriculture Department pays 40–50% of the price of farm machines such as rotavators, seed drills, threshers, sprayers, super seeders, happy seeders and agricultural drones. Farmer groups setting up a farm machinery bank or custom hiring centre get up to 80%. Booking opens online on the Agri Darshan portal a few times a year: in 2026 it opened in February–March and again in July. Selected farmers get a token, buy the machine from a listed dealer, and upload the bill and a photo. After a check, the subsidy is paid into their bank account.
40–50% of the machine price for farmers; up to 80% for farmer groups and machinery banks
A farmer of Uttar Pradesh registered with the Agriculture Department, with the registration linked to Aadhaar, land record and bank account
Farm land in your own name, as shown in the Khatauni
Small and marginal, SC/ST and women farmers get the higher 50% share. Other farmers get 40%
A refundable security deposit is paid when booking: Rs.2,500 if the subsidy is Rs.10,001 to Rs.1 lakh, and Rs.5,000 if it is above Rs.1 lakh
One booking per mobile number in each window. Farmers are picked first-come-first-served, or by e-lottery when bookings exceed the district target
The machine must be bought within the days given on the token, or the token is cancelled
Farmer registration number from the Agriculture Department
Bank passbook of the Aadhaar-linked account in the farmer's name
After buying: the dealer's GST bill and a photo of the farmer with the machine, showing its serial number
